data.rationale: The proposal follows the same sequence as the true workflow (Gutenberg search, then IMDb search, then a Notes entry with the same template) and has the right single parameter. Feasibility loses a point because the note template uses {title} instead of {book_title}, and the book and film choices are vague ("most-downloaded", "chosen film adaptation") where the true workflow says "matching book" and "first film adaptation".
